text: Yes, the JRC map supports the 2023 tree-cover loss. The evidence confirms a 0.7 ha loss within the asset, mapped by Hansen/UMD in 2023. The JRC 2020 reference map agrees with 100% of the event area, corroborating the loss. However, the JRC map alone doesn’t specify the cause, legality, or responsible party—it only confirms forest presence in 2020. The loss area was a mix of planted forest (Eucalyptus species) and small patches under 0.5 ha. The JRC data aligns with the Hansen detection, validating the event.
